profile.name: E-662压电定位控制器
profile.description: 用于控制压电定位通道的硬件控制器，可将指定通道移动到目标位置、读取当前位置，并查询控制就绪状态、通道对象、通道相位以及位置上下限。常用于显微镜精密对焦和纳米级位移定位。
profile.description_en: A hardware controller for piezo positioning channels. It can move a selected channel to a target position, read the current position, and query control readiness, channel object, channel phase, and position limits. It is commonly used for precision microscope focusing and nanoscale positioning.
